name: churn-and-burn
title: The Churn and Burn: the all-or-nothing ADHD mess type
description: The Churn and Burn is the ADHD mess type that swings between a four-hour deep clean and weeks of nothing. Why it happens, and the first card to use.

faq.q: Why can I deep clean for hours but not tidy for five minutes?
faq.a: A deep clean has urgency, novelty and a big visible payoff, which is exactly what an ADHD brain runs on. A five-minute tidy has none of those. The swing is not a motivation problem. It is a reward problem, and the fix is to make the small version count as a win.

faq.q: Should I just stop doing deep cleans?
faq.a: No. Keep them if you enjoy them. The change is what happens between them. A tiny daily floor keeps the house from ever reaching unbearable, so the next deep clean is a choice instead of an emergency.
